label: TP
reason: Alert 1 (java/path-injection): alert-TP — resolved sink value is '/data/' + param where param is user-controlled input from request.getParameter('BenchmarkTest'). Although there is a pattern check (param.matches(pat)), the deployed pattern value is unknown and could permit traversal sequences like '../'. The sink expression at line 14 constructs a file path by concatenating user input directly without path normalization or canonicalization. This creates a classic path traversal vulnerability where an attacker could specify ../../../../etc/passwd or similar to read arbitrary files beyond /data/. The pattern-based filtering is insufficient without knowing the exact pattern content, and best practice requires explicit path validation or using secure APIs.

evidence.note: User input param from request.getParameter flows directly into Paths.get('/data/' + param) without path normalization
Sink: Files.readAllBytes(Paths.get('/data/' + param)) - file path constructed from user input
